records.destinationTreatment: Represent 404 S 5th St as one physical Dinner Roulette destination under the current consumer-facing Red Dragon identity. records.note: Elko County currently assesses RED DRAGON SPORTS BAR #201 at parcel 001-422-002, 404 S 5th St, with casino NAICS/use and 2025 value history billed in 2026. Nevada's current tobacco-retail list independently carries RED DRAGON SPORTS BAR #201 at the same address. Elko City Council minutes and Nevada gaming records support the Red Dragon #201 operation, while the official 2025-2026 Elko visitor guide markets the property as Red Drag Casino. The co-location question is now resolved by additional evidence: Elko City records show the same 404 S 5th parcel was developed as a Dotty's Casino project; current Nevada Restaurant Services hiring material groups Red Dragon #201 and Dotty's #214 under the same management assignment and lists both at 404 S 5th; current gaming-directory and CasinoCity material also list Dotty's #214 at that exact address. For Dinner Roulette's physical-destination model, these are not two independently routable places and should not be duplicated. Red Dragon remains the canonical current consumer-facing identity because current county assessment, licensing/tourism evidence, and the public Elko guide all support it. No direct numerical coordinate has yet cleared the parcel/building-point gate. The previously recorded 40.8286,-115.7634 values remain excluded as unsupported.
